shortDescription.default: VANTAGE - workspace provisioning and verified archive & retention for SharePoint lists

longDescription.default: VANTAGE provisions workspace work-item and archive lists in the current SharePoint site and moves completed or cancelled task records to the archive list using a verified copy, read-back check and audit log before the source item is removed. Uses SharePoint REST with the signed-in user's permissions only; no Entra ID app registration or API permissions are required.
